headline: AC leaking?
text: Your AC is leaking, and you just keep wiping it?

headline: Don't just wipe it
text: Hold on. A leak is a symptom, not a diagnosis.

headline: Common causes
text: A clogged drain, a faulty drain pan, an iced coil. And it can wreck your ceiling.

headline: Clean the filters
text: Filters first. Deewa says clean them at least once a month in summer.

headline: Set it to 24°C
text: Thermostat on twenty-four. Every degree higher saves up to five percent.

headline: Hidden leak?
text: Damp walls, musty smell, a water bill you can't explain? That's a hidden leak.

headline: Clean the water tank
text: Water tank? Clean and disinfect it every six months, with an approved company.

headline: Power tripping?
text: Power keeps tripping? Don't just reset it. Call a qualified electrician.

headline: Check your AMC
text: Signing a maintenance contract? Check what's covered: spare parts, call-outs, emergencies.

headline: Save this for summer
text: Fix small problems before they become big ones. Save this for summer.
